data.one_liner: A command-line utility to sort and format .arb localization files in Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: It reads specified .arb files from your pubspec.yaml configuration and formats them in ascending order along with their metadata keys. Developers can run a single command to maintain consistency and standardization across their localization files.
use_when: You want to keep your .arb localization files sorted and consistently formatted
You use intl_utils and need a clean way to organize translation keys
avoid_when: You use an all-in-one localization package like slang or easy_localization that manages its own workflows
You prefer manual sorting of translation files
strengths: Simplifies .arb file management with a single CLI command
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on sorting and formatting .arb files
Not an alternative to a full localization library
data.setup_notes: Add as a development dependency and configure file paths under the intl_utils_formatter key in your pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
intl_utils_formatter:
  files:
    - lib/l10n/intl_en.arb
    - lib/l10n/intl_ur.arb

# Run command:
# dart run intl_utils_formatter:format
